description: A power-set quotient modulo an ideal is nontrivial exactly when the ideal is proper.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.quotient_nontrivial_iff.{u} {α : Type u} (I : Order.Ideal (Set α)) :
  Nontrivial (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.SmallQuotient I) ↔ I.IsProper
